description: Given a list of integers arr, return a rearrangement of it in which all non-zero elements come first, in the same relative order as in arr, followed by all the zeros of arr. The result must be a permutation of arr (same length, same elements with the same multiplicities, so the number of zeros is unchanged). The list may be empty.
notes: List.isPerm is stated as multiset equality in Dafny and as sorted(result) == sorted(arr) in Python. The Dafny filter and idxOf helpers are recursive functions with {:fuel 10} so the verifier can evaluate them on the test inputs.
